content.title: EXCLUSIVE: Ideal Power Taps Kaimei Electronic To Distribute Products Across Asia
content.summary: Ideal Power Inc (NASDAQ:IPWR) on Tuesday announced a partnership with Kaimei Electronic Corp, a manufacturer of electrolytic capacitors, resistors, and motor fans. Under the deal, Kaimei Electronic will distribute Ideal Power's products throughout Asia. Kaimei Electronic and Ideal Power are partnering to promote Ideal Power's B-TRAN technology alongside Kaimei's product portfolio to its existing and prospective customer base.
